participant_id.Description: The participant identifier indicates the participant that was scanned.

session_id.Description: The session identifier indicates the longitudinal session at which the participant was scanned.

Levels.ses-1: The first neuroimaging session; all participants went through at least one neuroimaging session
Levels.ses-2: The second neuroimaging session (not all participants have a second session)
Levels.ses-3: The third neuroimaging session (not all participants have a third session)

run.Description: Run number; note that resting state scans were meant to have 2 runs, and nback scans were meant to have 1 run, but there are cases of an unexpected third run for resting-state scans if the MRI tech decided to re-do a run.

missing_events_tsv.LongName: List of scans missing events.tsv file
missing_events_tsv.Description: Sessions without an events.tsv file were excluded from task contrast GLMs.

Levels.pass: Scan is included in task fMRI GLMs
Levels.fail: Scan is excluded from task fMRI GLMs

response_time_all_na.LongName: List of scans where response_time was n/a for every trial
response_time_all_na.Description: Sessions where response_time was n/a for every trial were excluded from task contrast GLMs. This indicates that the subject was not paying attention at all or fell asleep in the scanner.

Levels.pass: Scan is included in task fMRI GLMs
Levels.fail: Scan is excluded from task fMRI GLMs

failed_fmri_QC.LongName: List of scans that failed fMRI QC for every trial
failed_fmri_QC.Description: Sessions that failed fMRI QC earlier were excluded from task contrast GLMs.

Levels.pass: Scan is included in task fMRI GLMs
Levels.fail: Scan is excluded from task fMRI GLMs

qc_determination.Description: The final determination of whether r not a scan was excluded from task contrast GLMs.

Levels.Fail: The scan is excluded. A scan fails if missing_events_tsv, response_time_all_na, or failed_fmri_QC fails.
